Latencies are medians over the calls in the row. In S4 a \emph{held} cell is the pack's review rule holding the call for a person; the scripted approver that plays the second attendee in S3 released those holds too, which a real operator would not. $^\dagger$S1--S3 for these two rows are from the previous day's run: the Anthropic account ran out of credit during this one, and no code on their path changed in between.}
